# Retained basis trace accounting repair

Independent review found that event frames retained recursive basis trees while
charging only owner counts. An idle zero-width product owner therefore cost one
cell even as each event copied its complete tree. The original formatted sources
are preserved, along with the exact production/test repair patch.

The correction preserves the prior charge for Unit, Bit and Bits atoms and adds
every non-root basis node in the actual retained before/after frames and quantum
input/output items. It computes this while borrowing the ports and rejects
before frame cloning or state mutation. The small regression uses a seven-node
zero-width basis and one H step with a near-used budget; it generates no large
program. It also checks success with sufficient budget and unchanged atom costs.

The unrelated observed `items_after_test_module` Clippy error is repaired by
moving the concrete Type implementation before its test module, without a lint
allowance or behavior change. No build, test or formatter was run by the repair
author. Root will record actual validation separately.
